## 1. Beta vstup
- **Purpose:** Přidání uživatele do uzavřené beta cohorty (direct link nebo invite kód) před/po registraci.
- **Key files:** `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\body-mind-on\pages\beta.js`, `lib\betaJoinClient.js`, `lib\betaCohortConstants.js`, `lib\betaInviteCrypto.js`
- **API:** `POST /api/beta/join`, `POST /api/beta/validate-invite`, `POST /api/beta/claim-invite`, `GET /api/beta/my-status`
- **DB:** `beta_cohorts`, `beta_participants` (+ RPC `join_beta_cohort`, `validate_beta_invite`)
- **Auth:** Direct join + claim = Bearer Supabase JWT; validate-invite = veřejné (bez PII)
- **Fallbacks:** Cohort full/closed → HTTP 409/403; pending join v localStorage dokončí po login (`hasBetaJoinPending`)
- **External:** žádné

## 2. Registrace
- **Purpose:** Multi-step dotazník → Supabase Auth účet → `body_metrics` → spuštění generování plánu + e-mail.
- **Key files:** `pages\start.js`, `pages\on-club.js`, `pages\chci-vip.js`, `pages\register.js` (redirect), `pages\signup.js` (redirect), `lib\registration\bodyMetricsRegistration.js`, `lib\authHelpers.js`, `lib\registrationRules.js`
- **API:** `POST /api/body-metrics` (hlavní), `POST /api/retry-initial-plan`
- **DB:** `auth.users`, `body_metrics`, `memberships`, `user_habits`, `ai_tasks`, `profiles`
- **Auth:** Veřejný POST + rate limit; vytvoří auth user přes `service_role` (`createAuthUserIfNew`)
- **Fallbacks:** Existující e-mail → 400; plán timeout → inline scheduler + `persistPublishableFallbackPlanForUser`; ON_CLUB/VIP checkout vypnutý → 403 waitlist
- **External:** Supabase Auth, e-mail (Resend/SMTP přes `lib\mail.js`)

## 3. Onboarding
- **Purpose:** Sjednocený START flow; legacy `/onboarding` → `/start`; volitelné náhrady jídla/cviku během onboardingu.
- **Key files:** `pages\onboarding.js`, `pages\start.js`, `lib\onboardingMetrics.js`, `lib\planGenerationUiCopy.js`
- **API:** `POST /api/onboarding/generate-plan`, `POST /api/onboarding/replace-meal`, `POST /api/onboarding/replace-workout`
- **DB:** `body_metrics`, `ai_generated_plans`, `ai_logs` (onboarding audit)
- **Auth:** generate-plan = veřejný/dev; replace-* = typicky bez membership gate (onboarding kontext)
- **Fallbacks:** generate-plan volá `runUnifiedPlanPipeline`; replace-workout = šablony + wger (`workoutTemplates.js`)
- **External:** OpenAI (volitelně), Spoonacular, wger

## 4. Plan generation
- **Purpose:** Jediný orchestrátor: body metrics → structured plán → HTML → persist/e-mail.
- **Key files:** `lib\unifiedPlanPipeline.js`, `lib\services\planOrchestrator.js`, `lib\services\planOrchestratorResolve.js`, `lib\services\deterministicFallback.js`, `lib\taskExecutors.js`, `lib\aiScheduler.js`, `lib\generatePlan.js`
- **API:** `POST /api/generate-plan`, `POST /api/onboarding/generate-plan`, `POST /api/generate-plan-next-week`, `POST /api/body-metrics` (inline), `GET /api/ai/run-scheduler`, `GET /api/ai/run-coach-scheduler`
- **DB:** `ai_tasks`, `ai_generated_plans`, `body_metrics`, `recipes_catalog`, `exercise_asset_registry`
- **Auth:** Public rate-limited (`generate-plan`, registrace); scheduler = `Bearer CRON_SECRET`
- **Fallbacks:** OpenAI fail → katalog (`recipes_catalog` + `deterministicFallback`); Spoonacular quota gate; async enhancement; last-resort publish v registraci
- **External:** **OpenAI**, **Spoonacular**, **wger.de**, Withings signály (volitelně do promptu)

## 5. Plan storage
- **Purpose:** Persist aktivního týdenního plánu (HTML + structured JSON), deaktivace starých, unique per user/week.
- **Key files:** `lib\unifiedPlanPipeline.js` (`persistPlanFromUnified`), `lib\taskExecutors.js`, `lib\planHtmlStructuredBackfill.js`, `pages\plan\[id].js`
- **API:** implicitně přes generování; `GET /api/profile`, `POST /api/plan-enrichment`, admin backfill routes
- **DB:** `ai_generated_plans` (upsert `user_id,valid_from`), `workouts` (historie), `meal_metadata_cache`
- **Auth:** Zápis = `service_role`; čtení plánu = Bearer JWT + ownership v API
- **Fallbacks:** Chybí `structured_plan_json` sloupec → retry insert bez JSON; repair wrapped HTML v profilu
- **External:** žádné (DB-only)

## 6. Profil

- **DB:** `body_metrics`, `ai_generated_plans`, `workouts`, `user_habits`, `habit_logs`, `memberships`, `profiles`, `withings_connections`, `body_measurements`, `daily_*`, `ai_messages`
- **Auth:** Bearer JWT → `supabaseServer.auth.getUser`; čtení přes service role server-side
- **Fallbacks:** Email reconciliation při null `user_id`; `ensureInitialPlanTask` pokud chybí plán; repair plan HTML
- **External:** Withings status (integrace)
